description: Grama isn’t just beautiful, it’s full of history. Back in the time of the Illyrians and the Roman Empire, it served as a natural shelter for sailors. You can still see inscriptions carved into the rock by ancient soldiers and navigators, something quite rare in the Mediterranean. #albania #travel #summer #beach #boat
